name: fis-support-copilot
description: Embeddable production-support copilot for F&IS applications: hosted pure-JS widget + gateway into Eliza (Claude + knowledge MCP stand-in for local dev)

scripts.test: npm test -w packages/widget && npm test -w packages/gateway && npm test -w packages/knowledge-mcp
scripts.dev: npm run build && ELIZA_MODE=mock AUTH_MODE=none APP_REGISTRY=config/apps.example.json ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 node packages/gateway/src/server.js
scripts.dev:claude: npm run build && ELIZA_MODE=claude AUTH_MODE=none APP_REGISTRY=config/apps.example.json ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 node packages/gateway/src/server.js
